title: First Guest
subtitle: Comparing Means Assignment · t-test, Tukey, pairwise tests
story: You own Calmarupe, the old bathhouse spa cut into the sea cliff at the foot of the city. The first snow fell in the night and now it is dawn, the morning after, and every roof above is white. Diana Volpe, your fiercest rival, is already stepping into one of the iron-and-glass lift towers at the harbor with her friends: your spa's first guests of the day, and the last people you want finding a flaw in your bathhouse. Certify the water in every bath before Diana's party arrives: the cold plunge, the brine cave, the warm hall, then the springs on the clifftop terrace.

done.title: The bath are fixed!
done.body: Every bath, assessed — cold plunge to clifftop spring, nothing out of balance and nothing for Diana to find. Now to be gone before she steps out of the lift.

escapeDone.title: First tracks
escapeDone.body: The five candles burn in their pattern and the five bells ring out across the white roofs. Far below, her lift clanks to a stop at the clifftop, and every bath in Calmarupe already reads true: flawless, and first. Let her find nothing.
